hub.speaker: Selys
hub.text: Guild's closed for lunch. Unless you're here about the thing Erin won't stop signing her letters about?

text_variants.text: Guild's near closing. If it's paperwork, it keeps till daylight. Come back when I've slept.
Back again. Erin's errand is filed and finished — which puts you one paperwork grade above most adventurers I deal with. What now?
Word from the cisterns — there was something living down there, and it's been dealt with. The file crossed my desk this morning with your name on the referral line.

options.text: Erin's package. I'll spare you the small talk. (Lyonette's advice)
Shivertail. Any relation to the Guildmistress?
Anything on the board worth my time?

options._comment: #438 EQUIPMENT GAPS, civil-utility T2.5 -- the delivery-line fork the sketch asked for, and the lane's one true QUEST-REWARD channel (the other eight items come off vendors, loot and sealed-area treasure). APPENDED LAST and accomplishment-gated on the long-leg run, so it is HIDDEN at every fixture that has not delivered it and the hub's shipped 11-row option array is unchanged where the pins read it. hide_when retires it after one grant, the pallass-papers convention directly above.
options.text: The long legs are telling on my feet. Does the Guild do anything about that?

runner_sandals_given.speaker: Selys
runner_sandals_given.text: Officially, nothing. Unofficially there's a box under this desk of what Runners left behind, and a pair in it somebody wore to the shape of a road and then stopped needing. Take them.

selys_board_context.speaker: Selys
selys_board_context.text: The board's behind you. Reading it is free. Taking a posting means telling me, so I can log it and not have to chase you across Liscor. Anything else worth walking to, write it down — that's what the leads page in your journal is for.

selys_gran.speaker: Selys
selys_gran.text: Grandmother. Yes, that Tekshia Shivertail. Yes, she still throws a spear better than half the Silver-ranks. No, I will not introduce you when she's in a mood, which is always. I wanted to be her when I was small. Then I noticed the paperwork ran in the family too, and took the desk side of it. The hours are better, most weeks.

options.text: You wanted to be a hero?

selys_gran_two.speaker: Selys
selys_gran_two.text: Everyone behind this counter did, once. Then you log your first casualty report. The desk keeps more people alive than a sword does. Took me years to believe that. You don't have to believe it today. Board's behind you, and I've got intake forms with the Guild's name spelled wrong on them.

selys_board_pick.speaker: Selys
selys_board_pick.text: One job. I flagged it because the client isn't insane and the pay is honest: a courier run out to Riverfarm, nothing that bites back. Bring me the receipt. You get squared from the Guild's own purse, and the client's excuse for one never comes into it.

delivered.speaker: Selys
delivered.text: Finally. Here - she overpaid the courier fee, as always. Take it back or keep it, I honestly don't care which.

delivered_smooth.speaker: Selys
delivered_smooth.text: Hm. Someone's been talking to Lyonette. Fine - here's the fee Erin overpaid, and tell that barmaid she's wasted on pouring drinks.

pallass_sponsor.speaker: Selys
pallass_sponsor.text: Pallass. Guild's got the standing arrangement. I file the sponsorship, you cover the clerk's fee — fee first, actually. It goes through same-day. Ten gold, paid to the Guild, not to me.

pallass_sponsored_reaction.speaker: Selys
pallass_sponsored_reaction.text: Filed and stamped — same-day, like I said. The Door will answer for Pallass the next time you ask it. That arrangement took the Guild years.

errand_kept.speaker: Selys
errand_kept.text: Courier's fee it is. Erin won't miss it, and you look like someone who walked the Floodplains to earn it. We're square — tell her the package landed.

errand_returned.speaker: Selys
errand_returned.text: Sent back, then. She'll spend it on flour and act like she won an argument. You did the walking and took nothing for it. Noted. Now I owe her a return slip, and she never signs them the same way twice.

text_banks.the_erin_file_is_closed: The Erin file is closed. Guild business, the board's behind you. Gossip, go ask Lism.
